outcome: Total thickness of the uterine wall at the thinnest scar site
Proportion of fibrosis in the scar
cohort: Sixty women who underwent hysterectomy for benign pathology, divided into a group with previous CS and a control group without.
finding: Uteri with previous CS scars exhibited significantly reduced total wall and myometrial thickness, along with a significantly increased proportion of fibrosis, compared to adjacent healthy tissue and healthy uteri.
mod_finding: Previous caesarean section results in a significantly thinner uterine wall and myometrium, and increased fibrosis in the scar, which persists even very long after the procedure.
